support.locator: contains:Natural-language interpretation is outside this implementation

locator_checks.observed: The checker consumes structured ASTs and supplied provenance. It does not verify URLs or infer whether a natural-language slogan was translated correctly.

observed.note: The first comparator reported 20/80 because it compared unlike value representations. Attempt 02 compared the same immutable output JSONL and obtained 80/80; both are retained.

The original 1.0.0 implementation escaped on huge integers, invalid UTF-8, and an unpaired surrogate, and admitted a 13-digit AST constant. The repairs are supplemental and do not change the historical 80/80 score.
Hash-matched retained 1.0.1 source independently reproduces a ValueError while serializing a valid 8,400-digit exact result.
This preliminary attempt intended to reproduce 1.0.1 but imported already-edited 1.0.2 bytes; it self-identifies 1.0.2 and is excluded from all conclusions.

The large-output implementation and Decimal checks passed, but an auxiliary negative-fraction check forgot Fraction gcd reduction. Attempt 02 fixes only that evaluator expectation and passes all 16 checks; both are retained.

locator_checks.observed: These corrections do not change either reviewer's original labels, the 21/24 agreement count, any adjudicated label, or any source-only descriptive count.
